title: Walk Tracker
description: This plugin creates a scoreboard ranking the top 10 players by the distance they've walked on the server.
body:
WalkTracker is a plugin that turns exploration into a friendly server-wide competition. By leveraging Minecraft's accurate, built-in statistics, the plugin tracks every block a player travels on foot and displays this data on a scoreboard visible to everyone. This board features a "Top 10 Travelers" ranking that updates periodically, ensuring it doesn't impact server performance.

In addition to the public ranking, the plugin includes the /distance command for players to check their personal records and provides admin tools to set or add distance to any user's stats, making it perfect for events or manual adjustments. It's an ideal addition for survival, RPG, or exploration-focused servers, adding a new layer of engagement that rewards the most dedicated adventurers.
